newsitem.title: USA: Houston Exploration boosts drilling effort.
newsitem.headline: Houston Exploration boosts drilling effort.

text.p: Houston Exploration Co said it has secured the services of additional jackup drilling rigs, bringing the total available to the company to four, two of which are on a long term basis.
"These rigs will help accelerate our current offshore exploratory drilling program," chief executive James Floyd said.
The company also said it was awarded six lease blocks in the federal waters of the central Gulf of Mexico by the Minerals Management Services.
The company noted it was high bidder on these leases at the federal lease sale held in March.

Houston Exploration said the blocks are West Cameron Block 174, West Cameron Block 250, West Cameron 284, East Cameron Block 82 (east half), Vermilion Block 198, and South Timbalier Block 318. The company holds a 100 percent working interest in five of the six blocks and the bid amount for the six leases totaled about $5.4 million.
